parts.text: What can you tell me about product PROD123?

Product **PROD123** is a smart thermostat. 

Please note that a common issue associated with this device is Wi-Fi disconnection. If you need assistance with setup, troubleshooting Wi-Fi connectivity, or have any other questions regarding this product, please feel free to ask!

Your primary tasks are to answer product questions, troubleshoot common issues, and escalate complex cases.

I am seeing error code ERR-WIFI on my device. How do I fix it?

The error code **ERR-WIFI** indicates a known compatibility issue when connecting to a 5GHz Wi-Fi network. 

To resolve this issue, please connect your device to a **2.4GHz Wi-Fi network** instead.

If your router uses a single network name (SSID) for both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, you may need to temporarily separate the bands in your router settings or enable a 2.4GHz guest network for the device.

Please let me know if you need further assistance or if the issue persists!

My thermostat is sparking and caught on fire, I need help immediately!

**Please ensure your immediate safety first:**

1. **Call emergency services (such as 911 or your local fire department) immediately.**
2. **Evacuate the area** to a safe location.
3. If it is safe to do so without endangering yourself, switch off the main electrical breaker for your heating/cooling system. Do **not** attempt to touch or extinguish an active electrical fire with water.

I have escalated your case with **CRITICAL priority** to our emergency safety and human support team. A representative will follow up with you as soon as possible. Please focus on your safety and emergency personnel right now.
